raw_meta_yaml:
{% set name = "pygmailsorter" %}
{% set version = "0.1.0" %}

package:
  name: {{ name|lower }}
  version: {{ version }}

build:
  noarch: python
  number: 1

requirements:
  host:
    - python {{ python_min }}
    - setuptools
  run:
    - python >={{ python_min }}
    - gmailsorter >=0.1

test:
  commands:
    - pip check
  requires:
    - pip
    - python {{ python_min }}

about:
  home: https://github.com/jan-janssen/gmailsorter
  summary: Assign labels to emails in Google Mail based on their similarity to other emails assigned to the same label.
  license: BSD-3-Clause
  license_file:
    - LICENSE

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - jan-janssen
